## Engineering question

State the decision or numerical defect addressed, not just the files changed.

## Evidence

Source and exact equation/section; assumptions and units; baseline and proposed
behaviour; analytical oracle; negative tests; reproduction command; run identifier.

## Interpretation

What changed in the result, why it changed, and whether any decision changes.
State uncertainty, alternatives and conditions that invalidate the interpretation.

## Review

Identify source-code changes, data changes, oracle changes and tolerance changes
separately. Explain any changed tolerance; do not relax gates only to pass a test.
Record actual reviewers only. Solo review remains self-review, not independent approval.

## Rights and release

Confirm input provenance and permitted publication. Note outstanding limitations.
Do not publish confidential input, credentials, raw restricted data or unexecuted results.
